headline: Chinese Firms' Q3 Dividend Growth Lags Global Average Amid Market Slump
summary: Chinese listed companies recorded third-quarter core dividend growth of 5.3 percent, lagging behind the global average of 7.5 percent amid an ongoing market slump.
why: Corporate dividend growth is a key indicator of underlying corporate health and cash generation, influencing investor confidence in government market stabilization efforts.
